title_en: November’s Humble Choice Reveals a Full Lineup of of Bangers, Including Mafia: The Old Country, The Outer Worlds 2, and Many More
summary_en: November’s Humble Choice is live, and it’s full of bangers, including Mafia: The Old Country, The Outer Worlds 2, Shinobi: Art of Vengeance, and more.
body_en:
It’s the first Tuesday of November, and that can only mean one thing. Nope, not that today’s election day in the US, even though it is. It means a new Humble Choice bundle of PC games is available for super cheap ($14.99 to be exact). This month’s lineup is one for the ages. It includes Mafia: The Old Country, The Outer Worlds 2, Shinobi: Art of Vengeance, and more.
All told, you get eight games, all but one of which are redeemable on Steam. The code for The Outer Worlds 2 only works on Battle.net . Here’s a full list of the games included.
Mafia: The Old Country is the latest in the series and got an 8/10 in our review . Critic Luke Reilly wrote, “Mafia: The Old Country is a conventional but effective return to the linear and tightly story-driven format of the original Mafia and Mafia II, and it boasts a wonderful eye and ear for detail.”
The Outer Worlds 2 also got an 8/10 , with reviewer Travis Northup writing, “The Outer Worlds 2 doesn’t try to rewrite Obsidian’s RPG playbook, but it’s yet another strong refinement, with smoother combat, diabolically compelling buildcrafting and loot, and a story that immediately made me want to start again to see an alternate outcome.”
I’m also personally looking forward to playing Squeakross, because I love Picross puzzles, and it’s full of them. It looks colorful and super fun; it's been on my Steam wishlist ever since it came out. Overall, you can’t really go wrong with this month’s selections.
If you just want this month’s games, you can get it for $14.99 and then cancel your subscription. The games are yours to keep forever. Alternatively, you can save some money buy buying an annual subscription for $154.99, which saves you a little over $24 versus paying month to month.
Humble Choice members also get a handful of other benefits from the subscription. You get up to 20% off games in the Humble Store. You get access to a vault of games that’s always available as long as you’re currently a member. And a portion of your membership goes to charity. This month’s charity is Covenant House , which helps provide 24/7 safe shelter, food, medical and mental healthcare, and supportive services to young people experiencing homelessness.
For more deals, check out our full Black Friday coverage, which believe it or not, has already begun.
